name: io.github.seokhoonj/kis-trader
title: KIS Trader
description: Read-first MCP server for the Korea Investment & Securities (KIS) Open API; paper by default.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: Install kis-trader with the optional MCP extra so the kis-mcp console script is available (full launch: uvx --from "kis-trader[mcp]" kis-mcp).

environmentVariables.name: KIS_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: KIS Open API app key. Alternatively set KIS_MCP_PROFILE to a saved profile that already holds the credentials.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Account number in CANO-ACNT form, e.g. 12345678-01.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Name of a saved kis-trader profile to load credentials from, instead of KIS_APP_KEY/KIS_APP_SECRET/KIS_ACCOUNT.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: Trading environment. 'paper' uses the KIS simulation server; 'real' routes to the live server and additionally requires the real-order gates below.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_ALLOW_REAL
environmentVariables.description: First gate for live orders: set to '1' to permit real-order placement when KIS_MCP_ENVIRONMENT=real. Unset keeps live orders blocked.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_REAL_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: Second gate for live orders: an explicit confirmation phrase required alongside KIS_MCP_ALLOW_REAL before a real order is transmitted.
